dialogues.speaker: Scions of the Canopy General Message Board
dialogues.text: "At Chief Wayna's suggestion, this community bulletin board has been repurposed to serve as a general message board. Aside from being a place to display important news concerning the tribe, feel free to leave any other messages here too."

dialogues.speaker: Scions of the Canopy General Message Board
dialogues.text: "Both members of the Scions of the Canopy and visitors from outside the tribe are welcome to share feedback and requests at any time!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Amauta's Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Our shop handles custom orders for all types of extreme sports gear as well as souvenir clothing for tourists!"

dialogues.speaker: Amauta's Advertisement
dialogues.text: "In addition to fine ores supplied by the Children of Echoes and fabrics chosen by the Collective of Plenty, we also use various raw materials imported from abroad."

dialogues.speaker: Amauta's Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Prices are negotiable, however big the order~"

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement Addendum
dialogues.text: "Important note: When ordering custom grappling hooks, please provide accurate body weight measurements. No shame in a few extra pounds — as long as a Yumkasaur can still lift you, you're good!"

dialogues.speaker: Advertisement Addendum
dialogues.text: "Accurate weight measurements are crucial for grappling hook safety!"

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "This month, there were a total of eleven incidents. Nine involved damage to property and goods, and two resulted in injuries to travelers and personnel."

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Both travelers and new couriers — please, always exercise caution. Avoid reckless modes of travel, choose suitable paths and climbing routes, and prioritize your safety at all times."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Alright, alright, Uncle Wayna. You've told me this umpteen times already."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Mayta, you little rascal! Just because you haven't gotten hurt yet, doesn't mean it doesn't apply to you... You of all people should be extra careful!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "No way! You have to take a few tumbles if you wanna get better, hehe!"

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "...A gentle reminder from Aclla: When you're making friends with Yumkasaurs, make sure you adjust your approach depending on their age!"

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "Generally speaking, both juvenile and adult Yumkasaurs enjoy having their noses — the part that protrudes above their mouth — gently pressed by their companions. A bit like how friends might give each other a friendly pat on the back."

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "If you've got a baby Yumkasaur on your hands, they'll love a gentle ear rub."

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "Some Yumkasaurs approaching adulthood may be sensitive about people touching their ears. After all, they're no longer little kids anymore — in their own minds, anyway!"

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "Many little Yumkasaurs dislike it when other people groom their tails, for as their parents tell them, 'Little Saurians must grow up quickly and take care of themselves.'"

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "Adult Yumkasaurs, on the other hand, particularly enjoy having their tails groomed, as they love showing off how well-kept their fur is..."

dialogues.speaker: "Tips for Befriending Saurians"
dialogues.text: "A bit like a hairdresser telling you, 'Your hair's so thick and lush — must be hard trying to manage it all on your own!'"

dialogues.speaker: Sinchi's Message
dialogues.text: "If you need anything brought back, feel free to leave a message below. As long as it's within my abilities, I'll find a way to bring it back."

dialogues.speaker: Childish Handwriting
dialogues.text: "You wouldn't be able to bring back some meat for me, would you, Sinchi? I want to make some food for my sick little Saurian!"

dialogues.speaker: Sinchi's Message
dialogues.text: "No problem, I'll bring it back for you tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I want some chocolate, Sinchi!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Me too! Bring back some for me too!"

dialogues.speaker: Sinchi's Message
dialogues.text: "Hey now, it's not like Cacahuatl grows on trees, you know. Just reach down underground and dig some up for yourself!"

dialogues.speaker: "Small Cliff" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The safest and simplest of extreme sports you could imagine — perfect for beginners! Head over to the small cliff to experience the joys of climbing for yourself!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "How can something that safe even be called an extreme sport? Doesn't seem fun in the slightest. If this is what the rock climbing in Natlan's like, I might as well have just stayed at home and gone hiking on my own."

dialogues.speaker: Edited Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The most authentic and challenging of extreme sports you could imagine — perfect for those looking for a challenge! Head over to the small cliff to experience the joys of climbing for yourself!"
